Commentary.Commentary: The Pakistan bowling looked flat to begin with. Their bowlers did not get a lot of assistance from the surface and the dropped catch of Williamson also did not help their cause. Their spinner, Shadab Khan was also not at his best and hence they are now chasing a total which is just above par I feel. Their batsmen will have to bat out of their skins if they are to chase a target as it won't be easy against a brilliant Kiwi bowling attack. Will we see the away side being blow away or will they manage to spring in a surprise? Join us for the chase in a while.

Another excellent batting performance by New Zealand. After being put into bat, they will be mighty pleased. The pair of Guptill and Munro first got them off to a flier with a latter scoring a breezy half century. But this innings was all about Williamson, their skipper, who walked out after Munro's wicket and bagged a ton to his name. He was given a life early in his innings but never looked back after that. He was well supported by Martin first and then by Nicholls who himself notched up a more than a run-a-ball 50.

FOUR! A great way to end the innings for New Zealand! Southee was lucky but he wont mind. Amir bowls it full on off, Southee tries to flick but gets an inside edge through fine leg for a boundary. 9 runs from the final over and NEW ZEALAND FINISH ON 315-7!
TODD ASTLE walks out at no. 9.

OUT! In the air...caught! Santner had to go for it and he perishes in trying to hit a big one. Amir bowls it on a length around middle, Santner pulls, he connects well enough, gets the elevation but not the distance and holes out to Raees at deep mid-wicket.
Just back of a length on middle, Santner tries to pull but gets a bottom edge to the keeper. 2 balls to go.
FOUR! WOW! There was nothing wrong with the ball there. A very full delivery, almost a yorker on leg stump. Santner somehow manages to flick it through mid-wicket for a boundary,
Just one off the first two balls. Southee drives the full ball down to long off for a run.
Southee shuffles across. Amir uses his angle and bowls it full outside off. Southee fails to connect. A dot to begin the last over.
MOHAMMED AMIR to bowl the last over of the innings.
The batsman plays a pull shot to this short delivery. One run added to the total. Hasan finishes with figures off 10-0-61-3. He was expensive but did take three wickets.
Full on off, driven down towards long on for a couple.
FOUR! A gift for Southee but it still has to be put away. A full toss on middle, Southee winds up and thwacks it through mid-wicket.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Full on the pads, Southee fails to flick and gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards square leg and the batsmen take a leg bye.
TIM SOUTHEE walks out to the middle.

OUT! Hasan gets his third. He has this knack of picking wickets. Nicholls once again tries to be cheeky by playing a paddle scoop but this time he does not get the desired connection and it goes straight to Sarfraz Ahmed who takes a very easy catch. An enterprising innings by Henry comes to an end.
The batsman plays a pull shot to this short delivery. They manage to come back for the second.

Fifty for Nicholls. His fourth in ODIs! He has played with an attacking approach and provided the momentum New Zealand needed. Raees bowls it on a length on middle, Nicholls flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Slower ball on middle, flicks it with soft hands towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! CRUNCHED! Short on middle, Nicholls rocks back and pulls it hard, in the gap for a boundary.
MICTHELL SANTNER is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! They don't drop Williamson this time. Hasan Ali has made this skier look really easy. Raees bowls another slower ball outside off, Williamson makes room and tries to go big but ends up hitting it straight up in the air towards point. Hasan Ali positions himself under it and takes it by diving forward. Not easy those at would have been swirling in the air. Nevertheless an outstanding innings by Williamson comes to an end. He walks off to a standing ovation a deserved one.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
Back of a length on off, Williamson pushes it towards covers for a run.

Superb match awareness from the two batsmen! Henry drives it towards cover and sets off for a run but is sent back by Williamson. The fielder there fires a throw towards the bowler's end but misses. The ball hits the bowler and rolls towards mid-wicket. Seeing the fielder slow to the ball, the batsmen run a single.
Works it with the angle towards mid-wicket for a run.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. They pick up a single.
FOUR! How smart was that? Nicholls anticipated Hasan would bowl a yorker, he walks across, gets a full delivery and paddles it over the keeper for a boundary.
Brilliant! This is what the Pakistan bowlers are so good at. Hasan bowls a yorker on off, Williamson flicks it down to fine leg for a run.
Yes he has ended it well! Excellent over! Just six runs from it. Another off pace delivery outside off, Williamson cuts it towards covers for a quick run.
Another slower ball, a very slow ball outside off. Williamson swings at wildly but only connects with thin air. This is brilliant bowling from Raees. Can he finish it off well?

Uppish, in no mans land! A slower bouncer by Raees outside off, Williamson makes room and tries to pull it over long on. He does not time it and it lobs towards mid-wicket where there is no fielder and the batsmen take two.
Very full on middle, Henry jams it out towards mid-wicket for a run. A good over till now, only three singles.
The batsman plays the pull-shot. They pick up a single.
Fuller in length on off, driven through covers for a run.
A nasty bouncer on middle, Williamson tries to pull taking his eyes off the ball. It gets big on him and takes the top edge, down towards fine leg for a couple.
Works it through mid-wicket for a run.
Shorter in length outside off, Nicholls cuts it through point for a couple.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.

FOUR! 10th ton for Williamson and he brings it up in style. He was dropped earlier but take nothing away form his innings, he has been brilliant and has made Pakistan pay for it. He cuts the short ball through point to fetch himself a hundred. He takes his helmet off and raises his bat to the crowd who are on their feet applauding.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
HASAN ALI for a final burst.

OH! Ugly scenes out there. There is a big collision between the bowler and the batsman as they both were ball watching. Amir looks in a lot of pain as he down on the ground. He seems to be okay now after the physio had a look.

OUCH! Amir bowls a short one on middle, Henry pulls it towards Zaman at deep square leg who stops the ball. Nicholls sets off for a run and is ball watching as he fails to spot Amir and collides into him. Amir straightaway falls onto the ground in pain and so does Henry.
WIDE! Full and wide down the leg side and the umpire signals a wide.
One run shy of a hundred! Amir bowls it on a length on off, Williamson cuts it towards point but this time only for one.

NOT OUT! How quick is Williamson. He cuts the short ball towards point. He completes a run and then calls for a second. The fielder in the deep, picks the ball up and fires a throw to the keeper who whips the bails off and appeals. Williamson looks like he has made it but the umpire just to be sure goes upstairs. Replays show that Kane was well in. He moves onto 98.
They have gone upstairs to check for a run out appeal against Williamson at the striker's end. He seems to be safe but just to be sure.

In the air...but does not carry! Amir bowls a short one as he sees Nicholls come down the track. Henry still goes for the pull but only manages to get a top edge which lands well short of the deep square leg fielder. One added to the total.
Punches it off the back foot towards covers for a run.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. One run added to the total.
MOHAMMED AMIR is brought back into the attack.
Another bumper is pulled down to fine leg for a run. 10 from this over.

FOUR! Poor from the fielder in the deep! Nicholls charges down the track and pulls it towards deep square leg. The fielder there comes running towards the ball but is undone by the away spin. He tries to stop it by stretching out his left hand but can't get to it. 50-RUN STAND IS UP!
Full on middle, driven down to long on for a run. Williamson is just five away from a ton now.
Fullish ball on off, Nicholls presses forward and strokes it to mid off for another easy single.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
WIDE! Williamson tries to play the paddle by walking outside off, Faheem, seeing that bowls it very far outside off and the umpire signals a wide.
Starts off with a full ball on off, Henry drives it down towards mid off for a run.
FAHEEM ASHRAF to bowl his penultimate over.
Length ball outside off, driven through cover-point for a run.
A mistimed shot results in two! A slower bouncer on middle, Nicholls tries to pull but gets a bottom edge towards backward square leg and the batsmen bag a brace.
Tries bowling a yorker but ends up serving a low full toss on middle, Nicholls flicks it towards mid-wicket where the fielder makes a good stop and does not let the batsmen take a single.
Changes his angle and spears it on middle, Williamson pushes it down to long on for a run.
A slower ball outside off, Raees will be bowling a lot of these as it is the back end of the innings. Nicholls drives it through covers for a run.
Fuller on middle, tailing back in a touch. Nicholls flicks it to mid-wicket. A dot to start with.
Drags his length back, Henry pulls it to deep square leg for a run. 9 runs from the over.
FOUR! This spoils the over! Excellent innovation. Nicholls brings out the reverse sweep and connects well. The ball races through backward point for a boundary.
Flatter on middle, Williamson off the back foot pushes it down towards long on for a run.
WIDE! Fires it down the leg side. The keeper fails to collect and the batsmen take a bye.
Good bowling here by Khan! He has bowled three deliveries. He floats it up on middle, Henry pushes it towards covers.
Picks the googly and drives it down towards mid on for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled. Now 5 fielders can be placed outside the circle.
ALMOST A DRAG ON! Raees bowls it short outside off, Henry tries to cut but the ball stays a touch low, takes the inside edge and goes behind to the keeper.
A length ball around off, pushed to point. They need to bowl more dots if they are to build pressure.
Bangs it in on middle, Williamson who is very comfortable on the back foot, pulls it through square leg to change strike.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Fuller in length, driven firmly back to the bowler who makes a good stop.
Shorter in length on middle, Kane pulls it towards deep square leg. The fielder there, gets to the ball quickly and also releases it quickly and hence the batsmen can only take one.
BETTER! Tosses it up on off, Williamson plays a wristy shot down to long on for a run.
Bowls it quicker but on a shorter length, also stays a touch low. Williamson tries to pull but gets a bottom edge towards square leg for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Another half-tracker! Henry rocks back and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.

Khan is consistently bowling short here! It plays to his advantage though this time. Williamson come down the track but does not get to the pitch of the delivery. He adjusts and strokes it towards long off for a run.
Shorter in length on middle, Nicholls goes down on one knee and pulls it through square leg for a run.
Just ahead of a length on off, driven to mid off.
Back of a length outside off, Williamson plays it with an angled bat, down to third man for a couple.
Length ball outside off, Henry square drives it for a run.
Length ball on off, Nicholls presses forward and defends it towards point.
Comes around the wicket and angles it on the pads. Williamson pushes it towards mid on for a quick run.
Fuller in length on off, driven towards cover for a run.
RUMMAN RAEES is brought back.
Shadab I feel is rushing it here! He bowls it short outside off. Williamson cuts it through point to bag himself another brace.
Fires it on middle, Williamson blocks it off the back foot.
Tosses it up on off, Williamson defends it solidly.
Floats it up on middle, Nicholls tries to flick but gets a leading edge which goes uppishly away from the bowler but down to long on for a run.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Starts off with a leg spinner on middle, Nicholls goes down on one knee and sweeps it fine. Malik from deep square leg runs to his left and shows great skills with his feet as he stops it inside the rope. Three taken by the batsmen.
SHADAB KHAN is back into the attack.
Lands it on a length around off, defends it to point.
Back of a length on off, pushed to point.

FOUR! A poor ball to bowl with your fine leg up in the circle! Faheem errs in line and bowls it on the pads. Williamson flicks it fine, past the short fine leg fielder who gives it a chase, dives but all in vain.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.

On the shorter side on middle, Williamson picks the length early and pulls it through mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep runs to his left, puts in a dive and makes a good stop. Two taken by the batsmen.
Back of  a length on off, pushes it to covers.
Just a little short outside off, enough for Henry to get into position and cut it through point and down towards third man for a couple.
Fuller in length on off, Henry drives it to mid off.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Fuller in length on off, Henry tries to drive but it goes off the edge, down to third man for a run.
EXCELLENT DELIVERY! Hasan welcomes the batsman with a pin point yorker on middle. Nicholls is up to the challenge as he gets his bat down in time to keep it out.
Shorter in length outside off, Kane guides it down to third man for a run.
HENRY NICHOLLS walks out replacing TOM LATHAM.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! Pakistan are fighting their way back into the game! Faheem gets his first. Another soft dismissal. He bowls it on a length around middle, Latham walks across and tries to flick but there is no timing at all. The ball hits him high on the bat and lobs towards Azam at mid-wicket who accepts it gleefully.
WIDE! Ashraf bangs in a short one which bounces way above the batsman's head. Sarfraz does really well to jump and get a hand to it.
Shorter in length outside off, Latham who loves it there, cuts it through point for a couple.
Length on the stumps, Williamson lets the ball come to him and pushes it towards mid on for a run.
Latham walks across and flicks the ball outside off towards mid on for a run.
Hits the length hard around off, Latham keeps it out.
Shorter in length outside off, cut through point for a run.
FAHEEM ASHRAF is back into the attack.
Back of a length on off, Latham defends it onto the ground.
The batsman has driven it through mid on.
Good length on middle, defended off the front foot.
TOM LATHAM walks out at no. 5.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! The no. 1 ODI bowler in the world strikes again! Excellent delivery by Hasan. He comes running in and lands it on a length around off, gets it to jag back in sharply. Taylor is neither forward nor back as he tries to defend. He also leaves a gap between bat and pad, the ball sneaks through and hits the off pole. Another important breakthrough for Pakistan, they will be pleased to see the back of Taylor as he walks off cheaply.
Slower ball outside off, Williamson plays it with an angled bat down to third man to get off strike.
Just ahead of a length on off, Williamson pushes it to covers.
DRINKS ARE ON THE FIELD!

HAS THAT CARRIED? Amir finally bowls one full on off, it also shapes away a touch. Taylor pushes at it tentatively and gets an outside edge towards widish first slip. Azhar Ali there dives ahead but the ball seems to have fallen short. Yes, replays later on show it has fallen short of him. Luck is not going Pakistan's way here.
Length on off, Williamson guides it down towards third man for a run. Sarfraz wants Amir to bowl a little more fuller.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Poor by Amir, a slip was brought in and he bangs it in short on middle. Too easy for Williamson, who pulls it through the mid-wicket area.
A slip comes in now.

Time for a chat with the latest bowling coach for New Zealand, KYLE MILLS. Mills says that it is a great opportunity to be working with the team. Informs that it is currently not a permanent one and he was just asked by Mike Hesson whether he would be interested in the job. Honestly he says that he does not know a few pacers in the Kiwi side but is confident that he can do a good job. Admits that he is looking forward to accomplish the coaching role for Lahore Qalandars in the Pakistan Super League. On the windy conditions today, Mills admits that it will be challenging for the bowlers bowling into the wind. Wants his bowlers to be smart while bowling in the second innings.

EDGY FOUR! The change of angle almost does the trick! He comes around the wicket and bowls it full outside off, Williamson goes for the booming drive through the off side but only manages to get an outside edge which flies through the vacant slip region for a boundary.
Fuller this time on off, driven crisply to the man at covers.
Amir steams in and lands it on a length outside off. Taylor waits and plays it very late down towards third man for a run.
Another quick run! Fuller in length on off, Taylor pushes it towards mid on for a single.

Williamson is really connecting well on the pull shots! Another short ball on middle, Kane pulls it off the middle of his bat towards deep square leg. The fielder there does very well to make the stop. One run taken.
Shorter in length outside off, offers a little width. Taylor does like it there, he camps back and guides it towards third man for a run.

Bowls fuller on the pads, Taylor flicks it through mid-wicket and some good running by the two batsmen help them take two. Sarfraz is not a happy man as he wanted the fielder to put in a better effort.
Attacking the stumps is Hasan Ali. He comes running in and bowls it fuller on middle, Taylor drives it back towards him.
Goes wide of the crease and angles it into the batsman. Williamson flicks it towards mid-wicket and takes a quick run.
A false start as he comes running till the bowling mark but the batsman is not ready.
HASAN ALI is brought back on to bowl.
Bowls a slower ball on middle, Williamson tries to guide it down to third man but gets an inside edge onto his pads and towards point for a quick run.
Just ahead of a length on off, Williamson drives it to mid off.
Fuller in length outside off, Williamson strokes it past the diving cover fielder for a brace.
Good length on off, angling away. Williamson defends it towards covers.
FOUR! Pulled away with disdain! A short ball on the body of Williamson. He sees it early, gets into position and pulls it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Back of a length on off, Kane defends it onto the ground.
MOHAMMAD AMIR is back into the attack.
Fires it on the pads, Taylor plays it with soft hands towards mid-wicket and bags a brace.
Quicker on middle, driven back to the bowler.
Drives it with the angle towards long on for a run.
Flatter on the stumps, Taylor pushes it down to long on for a run.

FIFTY FOR WILLIAMSON! His 33rd in ODIs! He pushes the tossed up delivery down to long on for a run to reach the milestone. He raises his bat to acknowledge the applause from the crowd. Can he make it big now?
Dances down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it down to long on for a run.
The technical staff has got new bails. They will hope these don't fall off due to the wind. Might be a little heavier than the last ones.
Fuller ball on off, Taylor drives it down the ground to retain strike.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Floats it up on middle, Williamson defends it solidly.
Ross dances down the track. Shadab sees that and shortens his length. Taylor adjusts and taps it towards cover for a run.
A leg slip in place for Taylor.
Drags his length back, this time Williamson finds the gap with the cut shot. It goes towards sweeper cover for a run.
Shorter in length outside off, Williamson cuts it to point.
Works it against the spin through mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tosses it up on off, driven down to long on for a run.
ROSS TAYLOR walks out to the middle.

OUT! MAIDEN ODI WICKET FOR ZAMAN! A soft dismissal! Just as this partnership was starting to look dangerous, Zaman gets the breakthrough. He bowls it flatter outside off, on a shorter length. Guptill tries to cut but is done in by the extra bounce. He gets an outside edge towards short third man where Shoaib Malik takes an easy catch. A dejected Guptill walks back after a patient innings. The Pakistan players are pumped as they know how important this wicket is. Can they now build on the same?
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. One run added to the total.
SIX! Bad ball and dispatched! A half-tracker on middle, a nothing delivery. Williamson rocks back and pulls it over mid-wicket for a maximum. 150 up in style for the Kiwis.
FOUR! A boundary to finish! Guptill is getting into his groove now. Khan bowls another googly but shorter in length. Guptill picks it early, stays back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Comes down the track and drives it through mid off for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tosses it up on off, Williamson lunges forward and blocks it.
Fires it on the pads, Guptill tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards the leg side and the batsmen take a leg bye.
SIX! BOOM! Trademark Guptill! Khan bowls the googly but a little too full. Martin picks it and sends it sailing over long on for a biggie.
Change of ends for SHADAB KHAN.
LUCKY! Full on middle and off, Guptill leans to flick across the line but the ball spins away and takes the leading edge, just evading the man running back from cover! A run taken.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Comes down the track and drives it through extra cover for one.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Down the leg side, flicked fine for a single.
FAKHAR ZAMAN to bowl left-arm orthodox.
FOUR! Full and down the leg side, Guptill flicks it to the fine leg fence!
Stays back in his crease and defends.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Nicely done. A length ball on middle, Williamson jumps down the track and lofts it over mid on and gets it to the fence.
The batsman has played it to the point region. They manage to come back for the second.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. One run added to the total.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Outside off, defended from the crease.
A full toss outside off, driven straight to cover.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

EDGED, DROPPED! Sarfraz reacted a touch late. A length ball outside off, Williamson looks to guide it to third man but gets it off the outside edge. Sarfraz has just that half a second to react and is late. He has to dive to his right but the ball just goes off his glove to third man. A single taken.
A short ball, Kane heaves it through mid-wicket and gets a couple.
Full on middle, pushed towards long on for a run.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Loose shot. On a length wide outside off, Williamson reaches out to push but gets a thick inside edge to fine leg. Just a single.
How did that miss the stumps? A googly outside off, Guptill rocks back to cut but the ball stays low and just whizzes past the off stump!
Outside off, punched through the covers for a run.
Full and just outside off, watchfully blocked. 'YEAHHHH!' says Sarfraz.
Driven towards the mid off region. They pick up a single.
Outside off, pushed towards cover.
Full and outside off, Williamson dances down the track and wrists it to long on for a single.
Flays this through the covers and gets a couple.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Ohh... finally a boundary. Jumps down the track, reaches the length of the ball and thumps it through the covers for a boundary.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Full and outside off, Williamson gets across and then blocks.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Pushes this wide of mid on and takes a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Looks to cut this short ball but gets a bottom edge. A single taken.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Landed outside off, played straight to point.
SHADAB KHAN gets a change of ends.
The batsman gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads.
Short and outside off, cut away through point where Shadab Khan does well.
Outside off, this time the hap is exploited and a single is taken.
A touch short outside off, Williamson punches it straight to point.
And again.... another play and a miss.
Outside off, Williamson feels for it but misses.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
That is a sharp bouncer. Outside off, Martin takes his eyes off the ball as he looks to defend but the ball keeps on rising and hits his glove.
Some chin music for the batsman, he lets that bouncer through to the wicket-keeper.
A length ball outside off, extra bounce, pushed through the covers for a single. 100 IS UP...
Gets well across his stumps and fetches this from the 6th stump to the leg side, resulting in a defensive shot..
Outside off, Williamson gets across and defends
Outside off, played uppishly through point to sweeper cover for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Outside off, angling away, not played at.
Gets across his stumps and looks to defend but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full and wide outside off, driven through the covers for a s single.
DRINKS ARE ON THE FIELD NOW.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Full and outside off, Williamson reaches out, covers the outswing nicely and drives it wide of cover. Babar Azam chases it down, dtives near the fence but a a patch of grass comes off. Nearly injures himself. Three runs taken.
Very full, watchfully defended again.
The batsman has driven it straight down the ground.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
FOUR! Nice shot. On a length on middle, Guptill just lofts this through the line, over mid on and gets a boundary.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Outside off, played through point for a run.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! A tad short outside off, Williamson arches back and cuts it over the slip cordon to third man.
Landed outside off, watchfully defended.
Another change. FAHEEM ASHRAF is the new bowler. Just the one over then for Shadab Khan.
Gets well across his stumps and looks to force this through the off side but misses. 11 from the over but a wicket of Munro as well.
A length ball outside off, Williamson pushes at that and gets a thick outside edge, which flies between second slip and gully to third man. A run taken.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball - but fails.
KANE WILLIAMSON walks in at number 3, replacing Munro.

OUT! Munro departs! 'Told ya, didn't I?' I am not saying that but Sarfraz' reaction seemed to suggest that. The world's numero uno bowler strikes. A length ball outside off, Munro looks to flay it through the off side but can only nick it behind to Sarfraz who completes the formalities and then signals towards the bowler as if giving a practical explanation of the theory discussed a ball before. Munro falls for 58, perhaps a century was there for the taking.
FOUR! Wrong line, down the leg side and Munro is too good a batsman to miss out. Tickles it to the fine leg fence. Sarfraz runs to his bowler and has a long chat.

SIX! In the air... sails over! Yet another half century for Munro. His 5th in ODIs. He is looking ominous now. A length ball outside off, Munro pulls this high in the air but the timing is not that great. Mid-wicket at the fence thinks he has a chance but the wind pushes the ball beyond the ropes.
A full toss outside off, driven through mid off for one.
Outside off, pushed towards long on for a run.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Another single down the ground to long on.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a run.
A full toss, on middle and leg, pushed down to long on for a single.
Spin is in. SHADAB KHAN to bowl now.
FOUR! Edged away! Full and outside off, Guptill pokes at it but the ball flies off the edge past the diving first slip fielder to the third man fence!
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Works this down the leg side for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Pushes this towards mid off and takes a quick single.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
HASAN ALI now comes on.
POWERPLAY 2 has been signalled. Upto 4 fielders are allowed outside the 30-yard circle for the next 30 overs.
Nothing. Just a forward press to end the over. 15 from the over, New Zealand end Powerplay 1 on 62/0!

SIX! 'Are you kidding me?' asks Ian Smith on air. What a shot. This is called toying with the bowling. Full and outside off, Munro gets down and literally sweeps it, yes, sweeps it and gets it over mid-wicket! What is up for the final ball?
FOUR! Intentional. Short and wide outside off, Munro slashes this over point and gets consecutive boundaries to his name!
FOUR! AUDACIOUS! A short ball outside off, Munro pulls it over wide mid on, one bounce and into the fence! The 50-RUN STAND is up in quick time and New Zealand are looking to push on.

Down the leg side, Guptill misses out. Fine leg was inside the circle and a slight touch on that would have taken the ball to the boundary. Martin tries to flick but the ball hits his thighs and goes wide of short fine leg. JUst a leg bye.
Full and around off, swinging in a touch, watchfully defended.
What happened there? Hasan Ali was originally scheduled to bowl but at the last moment, Rumman gets the ball back.
Full again, flicked again, but not with great timing. A couple through mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, punched straight to Hasan Ali at mid off.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

FOUR! Plenty of real estate out there and Munro just utilizes that. A half volley on middle and leg and there is only one man in that region, around square leg. Flicked through mid-wicket with outstanding timing.
Landed outside off, defende from the crease.
Full on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple.
A short ball now, pulled away for a single.
Down the leg side, clipped fine for a single.
The ball strikes the batsman very low on the pads.
WIDE. Frustration from the bowler, bangs it in the middle of the pitch but down the leg side. Martin ducks and the umpire signals one bouncer for the over.

WIDE. Oh dear... comic scenes out in the middle. Raees bowls this down the leg side and Martin looks to flick. He misses it and as the ball goes past, a noise occurs. Sarfraz collects and appeals and the umpire signals a wide! Sarfraz is not happy. He is frustrated to no end on that wide call. Replays show the bat hitting the pad. Perhaps it was a wide after all.
A short ball now, pulled through the leg side for a single.
Fullish on middle, driven through mid on where Mohammad Amir dives to his right and parries the ball away. Two runs taken.
Outside off, pushed through point for a single.
Landed outside off, now Guptill steers this behind point for a run.
Outside off, punched through point for a single. The stand is now worth 30 from 41 balls.
Second slip has now been moved to cover.
Outside off, punched towards cover.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to mid off.
FOUR! Terrific timing. Badly lined, bowling this too straight, down the leg side, Munro just helps it behind square leg and gets a boundary!
That is a fine shot. Landed outside off, comes back in a long way, Munro is caught in his crease as he looks to flick and is hit on the pads. Perhaps height was the issue as no one appealed.
Outside off, punched straight to cover.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Down the leg side, flicked through the leg side for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Around off, nipping back in, Guptill looks to tuck it away but misses and is hit on the pads.
And again... the bails come off! Eventually, common sense has prevailed and the bails have now been taken off.
A short ball outside off, Munro pulls it with disdain but Sarfraz has a man exactly for that shot, at deep square leg. A single taken.
More issues with the wind as the bails keep falling off at the bowler's end. Not in anyone's control, but might be better off if they play without those bails.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Yorker outside off, Martin digs it out.
Around off and outside, watchfully defended.
Once again, the bails come off at the non-striker's end. Amir is stopped in his run up.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
A bouncer on middle, Guptill ducks.
Outside off, played straight to point.
Full and wide outside off, driven straight to cover.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Outside off, left alone.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
It is pretty blustery out there. The bails at the bowler's end come off and the umpire is putting them back on.

SIX! ADMONISHED! Guptill is coming to the party today. Munro is not quite able to tee off but not a worry as long Guptill has his lorry ready. A length ball on middle, Guptill lofts this through the line and hits it as straight as an arrow, right back over the bowler and all the way over long on!
Landed outside off, angling away, left alone.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They manage to come back for the second.
FOUR! Terrific shot! On a length outside off, Munro punches this on the up through the covers and gets a boundary!
On middle, Colin flicks it neatly through mid-wicket and earns a couple.
Works it down the leg side for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
A bouncer on middle and leg, Guptill ducks.
Poor effort from Pakistan on the field. On a length, outside off, Munro punches this on the up through the covers and the batsmen take a couple.
A full toss outside off, swinging in, Munro looks to drive, then tries to flick, manages neither and is comprehensively beaten. The ball goes under the bat.
Full and outside off, Guptill drives this through the covers and picks up three.
Fuller on middle, chipped uppishly towards mid on.
Full and wide outside off, left alone. Waqar Younis on air reckons that the ball should swing back in but the ball just goes away with the angle. Waqar is surprised...

LEADING EDGE... SAFE! Lucky escape for Munro. Has he signed a contract with Lady Luck or something? We saw this plenty of times in the Windies series. Pakistan will hope it does not get carried forward like an employee's annual leaves. Full and outside off, swinging in, Munro is early into his flick and gets a leading edge which goes wide of mid off. A single taken and New Zealand are on the board.
RUMMAN RAEES to bowl from the other end with the second new ball. Two left-arm seamers to begin with...
That is a good probing maiden from Amir. This is just outside off, pretty full, angling away, Martin watchfully lets it through.
Full and outside off, a touch wide, shouldered arms to.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
This time makes the batsman play and Martin is solid in defense.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Nice ball first up. On a length outside off, Guptill lets it go through with the angle. Nice carry to the keeper.
MOHAMMAD AMIR to start off the tour. Martin Guptill and Colin Munro are the openers with the former to take strike. Here we go...

The anthems are over and it is now game time. Pakistan look a pumped up lot. The Kiwi openers on the other hand, look calm and composed. Kane Williamson wanted to bat first anyways, so both captains have got what they wanted, unless Williamson is bluffing, which does not look like it, given his gentle nature.
Time for the national anthems. Pakistan's one being played first.
Playing XI - Pakistan - Azhar Ali, Fakhar Zaman, Babar Azam, Shoaib Malik, Mohammad Hafeez, Sarfraz Ahmed(w/c), Faheem Ashraf, Shadab Khan, Mohammad Amir, Hasan Ali and Rumman Raees.
Playing XI - New Zealand - Martin Guptill, Colin Munro, Kane Williamson(c), Ross Taylor, Tom Latham(w), Henry Nicholls, Mitchell Santner, Todd Astle, Tim Southee, Lockie Ferguson and Trent Boult.
TOSS - Sarfraz Ahmed calls it correctly and PAKISTAN WILL BOWL. The big guns are back for the Kiwis from a well-deserved rest.
It was heavily overcast an hour before but now the clouds have gone by, giving place to bright sunshine. But still, heavy showers are predicted, so fingers crossed.

If you thought cricket in New Zealand was over, don't be so sure. The Kiwi-Windies series was just the beginning of a longggg home season for the Black Caps. They now get set to host Pakistan for a limited-overs series which will be followed by the English competition. Phew! Plenty of cricket in this small country! Hello and a warm welcome to the first of the 5-match ODI series between New Zealand and Pakistan at the Basin Reserve, Wellington.
